review_scope: 读取既有审查、Phase 0/1 与两分支当前草案；未运行模型、实验、集群或重 I/O；不修改候选目录。

candidate_reviews.name: Signed Temporal Residual Calibration (STRC; earlier status names Temporal Residual Feedback Calibration, TRFC)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: phase2_generate candidate now exists; no coherence artifact at review time; TENTATIVE_MECHANISM.zh.md is non-canonical
candidate_reviews.rationale: The temporal residual direction was promising, but the current Phase 2 candidate computes A(q) from a natural q-versus-FP state-drift branch while computing A_pi(q) from a different FP-path injected shuffled-action branch; their difference cannot identify temporal order. Combined with the earlier K_r association/sign problem, the gamma=1 terminal-drift degeneracy under transition-residual readings, and a fake-quant logical-byte cost mislabeled as measured packed bytes, repairing the load-bearing estimand requires a new transport/intervention mechanism rather than a local revision.
strengths: D_H(q) formed by a signed discounted vector sum can preserve cross-lag inner-product terms and therefore cancellation, unlike an unsigned sum of residual energies.
Re-evaluating each pre-registered joint group on the current full map could expose interaction and avoid the old independent single-site score failure.
The proposal removes the optional delta-action accumulator, avoiding a direct drift into generic observer/error-feedback or Feedback World Model territory.
The proposed downstream endpoint is physical closed-loop drift/task outcome, rather than treating the calibration score itself as success evidence.

current_load_bearing_objects: D_H(q)=E[||sum_(ell=0)^(H-1) gamma^ell W e_(t+ell)^q||_2^2] in TENTATIVE_MECHANISM.zh.md

blocking_findings.finding: K_r is a cross-covariance/association under paired trajectories, not a causal transfer kernel.
blocking_findings.why: Initial state, timestep, task phase, action magnitude, shared random source, and policy feedback can jointly determine r_t and later e without a transfer mechanism.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Remove K_r from the load-bearing score, or label it strictly predictive association and add a real residual/action intervention whose treatment and downstream target are specified.

blocking_findings.finding: A score of sum_l ||K_r(l)||^2 discards sign and cannot support persistent-versus-canceling language.
blocking_findings.why: Entrywise or matrix norm squaring makes positive and negative lag covariance equally positive.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Use D_H as the sole signed score, with the vector-sum cross terms visible in the definition, or define another signed statistic and stop using the norm-squared K score.

blocking_findings.finding: The current phase-shuffle description is not an executable matched control.
blocking_findings.why: A global e sequence shuffle changes state/action and task-phase alignment; preserving a vague per-lag marginal energy does not specify a permutation that remains matched.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Apply a within-trajectory residual-trace intervention that preserves per-step magnitude strata, task phase, state/action strata and action magnitude while changing only lag order; state exactly whether the trace is injected into the simulator or only rescored.

blocking_findings.finding: A(q) and A_pi(q) are computed on different treatment paths in the Phase 2 candidate.
blocking_findings.why: A(q) uses natural q-versus-FP state-feature drift d_l, while A_pi(q) uses a cloned FP path with shuffled action residual injection; Delta_coh therefore mixes temporal order with model-path and controller-feedback differences.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Abandon the exact STRC formulation. A new candidate may use original-order and shuffled residual injection on the same FP cloned path, while reporting natural q drift as a separate endpoint.

blocking_findings.finding: same-state simulator replay leaves future quantized calls and the meaning of e_(t+ell) unspecified.
blocking_findings.why: Natural FP/Q rollouts confound the initial residual with later policy responses and environment dynamics; the current prose does not state the physical coordinate or reset/hold semantics.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Define r_t as the common-state, common-random-source Q-minus-FP action; define e as a fixed physical state/transition coordinate difference; specify future Q execution, reset points, and the held-out split.

blocking_findings.why: A latent coordinate sign or arbitrary orthogonal basis has no stable physical meaning; whitening alone does not make signs causal or task-semantic.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Use stable physical coordinates such as end-effector/object pose and gripper state, with pre-frozen units/scales; if only pixels/latent states are available, withdraw the physical sign-cancellation claim for that anchor.

blocking_findings.finding: If e is interpreted as transition increments, gamma=1 telescopes to terminal FP/Q displacement.
blocking_findings.why: The proposed gamma sweep includes 1.0, and a signed sum of transition increments then carries no new temporal structure beyond the terminal displacement.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Keep e explicitly as state-feature differences with a justified nonterminal horizon, or remove the gamma=1 reading; do not claim a new temporal mechanism from a telescoping identity.

mathematical_audit.coherence_status: current candidate has a load-bearing treatment-path mismatch; abandon exact STRC formulation and reassess only as a new transport-contrast mechanism

single_site_subsumption_audit.current_reading: The all-W4 to W4/W8 conditional swap wording is potentially joint, but the group definition and interaction evidence are absent.
single_site_subsumption_audit.risk: If every group is scored independently from all-W4, or conditional reductions are added as independent site gains, this is old single-site scoring with a new temporal score.

Each swap re-evaluates the full current map and records the conditional reduction after previous swaps.
At least one pre-registered two-group interaction diagnostic showing whether the score is non-additive; if interaction is absent and selection is additive, the method claim fails.
Matched unsigned-energy, sign-randomized, random-map and local/additive controls.

Whitening W source and freeze point, gamma/H selection before map fitting, and trajectory-level train/validation/test split.
A runnable phase intervention that changes temporal order without changing non-temporal distributions.

Whether DINO-WM low-bit execution is real packed/native or only fake numerical emulation.

Physical residual trace collection from the same reset state; no model/episode leakage across fit and held-out test.
D_H as the sole signed calibration score; compare against unsigned energy, sign-randomized trace, LocalMSE, DA-PTQ-style motion, random maps, and any architecture-valid QuantWAMs schedule baseline.
Greedy conditional group swaps with a pre-declared interaction check and downstream held-out drift/success endpoint.

post_abandon_salvage.minimum_distinction: The fixed Q0 history/latent slot delta and finite-difference transport contrast must be quantization-specific and must not reduce to ordinary QDrop/noisy-input reconstruction or Jacobian distillation.
post_abandon_salvage.review_rule: Treat this as a new mechanism; do not inherit STRC's novelty or verdict.

no_go_conditions: Use of sum_l ||K_r(l)||² as evidence of signed cancellation.
Phase shuffle changes state/action alignment or has no downstream effect relative to coherent traces.
No stable physical coordinate is available for e.
Conditional swap direction is unstable across fit seeds or is equivalent to independent single-site/additive scoring.
Unsigned-energy or sign-randomized control matches STRC, or raw-action/no-memory control matches it.

candidate_reviews.name: Frozen-Residual Transport PTQ (FRT)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: new conditional candidate in phase2_generate plus IDEA.zh.md; reviewed as a new mechanism after STRC was abandoned
candidate_reviews.novelty_status: conditional_domain_specific_hypothesis; not search-closed and not yet separated from generic sensitivity alignment
candidate_reviews.rationale: FRT is materially more coherent than STRC: a frozen Q0 residual is inserted into the valid newly predicted history slot and a one-step finite-difference transport contrast is matched at fixed W4 bytes. This removes the prior causal-kernel, signed-lag, phase-injection and observer problems. Its central novelty is still unproven because the objective is a directional local-response loss, adjacent to QDrop/noisy-input reconstruction, PD-Quant, Sobolev/JVP/GAD sensitivity matching and direct two-step matching. It should remain revise until a fresh-DEV Q0-direction gain survives explicit Jacobian/JVP controls and the physical interface is verified.
strengths: The Q0-derived delta is deployment-induced and quantization-specific by construction, rather than arbitrary input noise, provided it remains distinct from the final fitted residual.
The transport term compares F_theta(x+delta,a')-F_theta(x,a') with the matched FP finite difference, so it has a concrete estimand without claiming causal transfer or exact linearization.
Fixed W4 target blocks, no bit allocator, no deployment observer and no FP teacher make the proposed deployment boundary auditable.
Fresh DEV Q0 residuals, random same-norm deltas, clean reconstruction, QDrop/input-noise and direct two-step controls provide a plausible falsification route.

current_load_bearing_objects: delta_i=stopgrad(F_Q0(X_i,a_i)-F_FP(X_i,a_i)) stored in the newly predicted latent slot
L_FRT=clean FP/Q output term plus lambda_T times finite-difference transport mismatch

blocking_findings.finding: FRT may be ordinary directional/Jacobian sensitivity matching with a Q0-chosen direction.
blocking_findings.why: The transport contrast is a finite difference of the quantized map around x; QDrop/noisy-input, Sobolev/JVP/GAD and related sensitivity methods already cover the broad principle of preserving local responses.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Add an explicit Jacobian/JVP or multi-direction finite-difference control with identical W4 parameters, calibration budget and endpoint. Retain random same-norm delta as a separate isotropic control. If Q0 direction gives no fresh-DEV/downstream gain over these controls, abandon the FRT novelty claim and the candidate.

blocking_findings.finding: The frozen Q0 direction can become stale after scalar scales and rounding offsets are fitted.
blocking_findings.why: The optimized Q_theta may have a final residual delta_theta=F_theta-F_FP whose norm and direction differ from delta_Q0, so matching a stale perturbation does not establish preservation of the deployed quantizer's own residual transport.
blocking_findings.required_repair: On DEV report norm, cosine/alignment and transport ranking for final delta_theta versus frozen delta_Q0, without using final residuals to fit. State the intended Q0-proximal scope; if alignment is poor and fresh-Q0 transport does not transfer, abandon.

blocking_findings.finding: The physical loss is only valid if P is a stable, fixed readout from the predictor output to physical xy/goal-relative units.
blocking_findings.why: DINO latent coordinates alone do not supply physical displacement semantics, and an arbitrary or fitted readout could turn the objective into a proxy unrelated to closed-loop drift.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Pass a light interface gate before the pilot, freeze P and W_y using CAL only, and stop the physical claim if P cannot be verified. Latent-only results must be labeled diagnostic.

blocking_findings.finding: Injecting delta into x+delta must preserve the actual full-history state contract.
blocking_findings.why: Wrong slot, normalization, cache fields, temporal shift or broadcasting can create an off-manifold input and make the transport score an interface artifact.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Record the exact shift/concat, slot shape, normalization and cache restoration; verify x+delta is a legal runner input and keep all older slots unchanged.

blocking_findings.finding: Joint scalar calibration can still be a collection of local losses with a transport label.
blocking_findings.why: If two-block interaction is zero or unstable, all-block fitting does not demonstrate coupled closed-loop quantization and may simply add parameter freedom to clean PTQ.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Pre-register graph groups, report I_gh across fit seeds on DEV, and compare joint versus independent fits at equal W4 bytes. Require stable nonzero interaction and downstream gain for a joint claim.

mathematical_audit.coherence_status: coherent conditional finite-difference transport hypothesis; physical readout, valid history injection and stale-direction checks are hard gates

single_site_subsumption_audit.risk: Lower than STRC because there is no additive site score or bit allocator, but AdaRound-style per-block scalar/rounding fitting remains a possible reparameterized local PTQ objective.
single_site_subsumption_audit.required_test: Use the same target-block map and bytes for clean-only, direct two-step, QDrop/noise, random-delta, JVP and FRT fits; report joint versus independent two-block interaction and held-out physical endpoint.
single_site_subsumption_audit.status: conditional; no single-site scoring claim may be made before interaction and matched-budget tests

near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: FRT must show that a frozen Q0 deployment residual direction gives a fresh-DEV and downstream advantage over matched input-noise/drop reconstruction; otherwise it reduces to QDrop-like robustness fitting.

near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: FRT must show a transport-of-x+delta gain beyond final clean prediction difference and guard against small-CAL overfit with fresh Q0 DEV residuals.

candidate_reviews.name: Trajectory-Relational Product VQ (TR-PVQ)
candidate_reviews.artifact_status: STATUS.zh.md plus REVISION_RESPONSE.zh.md and Phase 1/selection artifacts; no completed phase2_generate candidate
candidate_reviews.rationale: A quantized-model-dependent action-trajectory relation objective could be a real domain-specific extension of weight VQ, but the one-paragraph sketch does not define the relation tensor, codebook optimization, block coupling, coordinate anchoring or deployment kernel. The Gram target has invariances that can preserve the relation while changing planner-critical action semantics.
strengths: The target is potentially tied to imagined trajectory behavior rather than only weight reconstruction, which can separate it from generic VPTQ/AQLM if the target changes with the quantized model.
The proposed distinction from action tokenization is conceptually correct: VQ-VLA action tokens are not backbone weight compression.
DINO-WM is small enough for a bounded single-card pilot, subject to the existing checkpoint and fake/native boundary.

blocking_findings.finding: A fixed-input action Gram does not depend on the quantizer and cannot train or select a weight codebook.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Define the Gram from quantized-model imagined trajectories for every codebook/index candidate and state the layer/block update path; otherwise the objective is not a weight-VQ method.

blocking_findings.finding: Gram geometry is invariant to global orthogonal action-coordinate transforms, and centered versions can remove translation.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Add a pre-frozen goal/coordinate/sign anchor, or prove the downstream planner is invariant; compare relational-only and relational-plus-anchor objectives under identical bytes.

blocking_findings.finding: The relation objective and codebook fitting may be local/coordinate-descent scoring with no global coupling.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Specify fixed graph groups, full-map or coupled-block objective, codebook/index update, and at least one interaction or joint-map diagnostic; remove rate-allocation claims unless measured and necessary.

blocking_findings.finding: The retrieval did not close relational knowledge distillation/task-aware VQ collision space.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Run primary-source collision queries for relational KD, task-aware VQ, output-geometry preservation, and action-trajectory distillation before claiming novelty. If an exact mechanism is found, abandon or reframe.

blocking_findings.finding: VPTQ/AQLM packed lookup format does not imply a DINO-WM native kernel.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Separate codebook/index logical bits, packed checkpoint bytes, peak device memory and synchronized kernel throughput; fake emulation cannot support native compression/latency claims.

near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: TR-PVQ must optimize a relation of quantized imagined trajectories, not just local weight/output reconstruction; fixed action inputs or a post-hoc Gram report is insufficient.

near_neighbor_audit.name: MotionVQ/VQVLA
near_neighbor_audit.actual_mechanism: Motion-aware execution-state dynamic precision and centroid-reuse accelerator for VLA inference.
near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: TR-PVQ must be a static trajectory-relation codebook objective, not motion-magnitude precision switching or a custom accelerator claim.

near_neighbor_audit.name: DA-PTQ
near_neighbor_audit.actual_mechanism: VLA Jacobian/motion drift surrogate and mixed precision.
near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: A VQ relation target must be clearly different from action-motion magnitude/Jacobian allocation.

near_neighbor_audit.name: QuantWAMs
near_neighbor_audit.actual_mechanism: WAM structural/distributional/objective calibration and reachable-state schedule repair.
near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: TR-PVQ must compress weight codebooks using a relation target, not reuse schedule auditing as its novelty.

near_neighbor_audit.name: Feedback World Model
near_neighbor_audit.actual_mechanism: Inference-time latent observer from real transition residuals.
near_neighbor_audit.actual_difference_required: TR-PVQ is only different if it does not add an online observer or generic residual feedback.

must_define: Action/trajectory object shape, candidate indexing, horizon, normalization and whether Gram is centered.
How every candidate codebook/index changes imagined trajectories and how codebook entries are optimized or assigned.
Layer/block group granularity, all-map coupling, fixed-byte budget and tie/update rule.
Relational knowledge distillation/task-aware VQ baselines and exact native/fake deployment path.
required_experiment_gate: At matched bytes, TR-PVQ must improve held-out candidate-pair geometry and the final planner action/return against LocalMSE and VPTQ-like index fitting simultaneously.
Relational-only must be compared with relational-plus-anchor; a Gram-preserving action rotation that harms the planner is a direct fail case.
Report logical bits, packed bytes, Peak VRAM, synchronized throughput, action fidelity and return separately.

a100_40gb.evidence: Existing audit places DINO-WM Wall CEM around 4.06 GiB, but the candidate-specific imagined-trajectory/codebook search and native kernel are unmeasured.
a100_40gb.limits: Do not infer native memory or speed from nominal VQ bits or inherited VPTQ/AQLM format.

a100_80gb.limits: 80GB cannot establish kernel availability, true compression, or a custom accelerator comparison.

allocation_plan: Start with one real PBS A100 allocation for a tiny codebook/index identity gate and one held-out trajectory check.
Expand only if the target depends on quantized trajectories and the goal-anchor ablation is informative.
Keep all heavy model loading, codebook search, hashing, I/O and timing inside a validated compute allocation, with PBS_JOBID/hostname/GPU checks.

required_revision_targets.issue: The objective may accidentally use fixed input actions and thus be independent of quantization.
required_revision_targets.fix_direction: Define quantized-model-dependent imagined trajectories and the exact codebook/index optimization loop.

required_revision_targets.issue: Gram invariance permits planner-harmful rotations and centered translation loss.
required_revision_targets.fix_direction: Add a frozen goal/coordinate/sign anchor and pre-register relational-only versus anchored controls.

required_revision_targets.issue: Relational KD/task-aware VQ collision was not searched to closure.
required_revision_targets.fix_direction: Search and read primary sources before any novelty certification; exact overlap routes to abandon or an explicitly narrower claim.

required_revision_targets.issue: Packed lookup inheritance is not native DINO-WM execution evidence.
required_revision_targets.fix_direction: Separate fake/logical compression from native packed bytes, VRAM and latency, and withhold the latter until measured.

no_go_conditions: The action relation is computed from fixed inputs and does not change with codebook/index choices.
Relational-only Gram matching permits a harmful rotation/translation and no coordinate/goal anchor repairs it without changing the central claim.
The method reduces to VPTQ/AQLM local fitting plus a post-hoc Gram report.
An exact relational/task-aware VQ ancestor subsumes the objective.
Native compression/latency is claimed from logical bits, fake quantization or a custom accelerator result.

cross_branch_decision.non_vq: abandon_current_STRC; independently review Frozen-Residual Transport PTQ as a new mechanism
cross_branch_decision.vq: revise_only; no novelty certification until objective, invariance, relational-VQ collision and native/fake boundary are closed
cross_branch_decision.release_gate: Do not advance either branch merely to deliver two ideas; every central claim must survive its stated no-go checks.

evidence_boundary.author_reported_or_retrieved: The listed papers' mechanisms and local feasibility records are source-grounded or locally recorded.
evidence_boundary.local_reproduction: No new reproduction was run in this review.
evidence_boundary.fake_quantization: Existing DINO W4/W8 screens are numerical emulation and do not establish native bytes, VRAM or latency.
